scope: Complete read-only source review of submission.py, features.py and model.py; no peer code executed, no raw data read, no model-design transfer into closed research.
training_only_dependency: model.py optionally imports scipy.optimize; submission.py imports features.py and does not import model.py, so SciPy is unnecessary for the reviewed prediction entry point.
findings: No network, subprocess, shell, arbitrary eval/exec, dynamic import, credential access or ID-keyed lookup was found in the reviewed source.

The prediction path reads only config.json, weights.npy, scaler_mean.npy and scaler_std.npy from the supplied checkpoint. NumPy load calls do not enable pickle; the execution environment must retain allow_pickle=False as its default.

The feature path consumes supplied question/candidate text and embeddings. No reference-answer file access was found. Training functions accept labels as parameters but are not called by submission.predict.

Arithmetic expression handling uses an explicit token parser and Fraction operations rather than Python eval. Long/deep or very large numerical strings remain a resource/exception risk, not evidence of arbitrary code execution.

Missing checkpoint files trigger a deterministic fallback rather than an error. Preflight must verify every expected checkpoint byte so that this fallback cannot silently replace the submitted model during reproduction.
required_runtime_boundaries: Use the exact anonymously hash-verified source and full checkpoint; verify numeric array headers/dtypes/shapes and resource size before prediction.
Use a fresh process with sanitized environment and explicit imports resolving features.py to the reviewed peer source; do not inherit unrelated PYTHONPATH or credentials.
Deny network, subprocess/spawn, writes outside the attempt outputs, and any reference/gold access during prediction; expose only official input assets and the pinned checkpoint.
Keep independent scoring separate from prediction, and enforce the agreed wall/process/thread limits even if parsing fails or becomes slow.
limitations: Static source review is not proof of runtime correctness, numerical fidelity, compliance, speed or score. Those claims require the separate bounded reproduction records.
